seeds.text: Your tiredness is honest. Your hustle isn't. Most "productivity" is a flight response with better marketing.
Slowing down is resistance in a body trained to perform. Speed isn't your nature — it was the price of belonging.
Being embodied isn't feeling good. It's feeling what's actually here — including the parts that aren't pleasant.
Your body isn't a machine. It's a memory keeper — every tight place is an old story still waiting to be heard.
The breath is always available. That's why it's the simplest doorway back into your own body.

slides.text: YOUR HUSTLE ISN'T PRODUCTIVITY. IT'S FLIGHT.
slides.composition: A shimmering, liquid chrome hourglass, half-empty, stands centrally against a deep navy cosmic backdrop, conveying urgency and metallic elegance.

slides.text: That constant push to do more? Often, it's just your body trying to outrun what's hard.
slides.composition: A lone, cel-shaded anime figure, seen from behind, runs endlessly through a blurred dreamcore landscape under a sky filled with prismatic light, evoking tireless escape.

slides.text: When you try to slow down, your system might fight back. It learned speed was survival.
slides.composition: Two chrome hands, one clenched and one gently open, are framed in a close-up against a textured, slow-motion starfield, symbolizing resistance and release.

slides.text: Every tight knot or ache holds a quiet story. Your body remembers what your mind forgot.
slides.composition: An ancient, glitching marble statue fragment, depicting a torso with intricate cracks, floats within an beautiful amber and violet painterly sky, suggesting forgotten narratives held within.

slides.text: Embodiment isn't about feeling good. It's about feeling what's here, without needing to fix it.
slides.composition: A single, luminous metallic tear drops slowly from an unseen source into a still, reflective pool, creating subtle ripples under a soft glow, symbolizing honest feeling.

slides.text: When everything feels too much, your breath is always waiting. A simple, quiet doorway in.
slides.composition: A soft, glowing, four-point sparkle hovers at the center of a wide-angle shot of a vast, tranquil nebula, feeling like a quiet, accessible anchor point.

slides.text: Your body is telling you the truth. Listen.
slides.composition: An architectural portal, crafted from flowing chrome, frames a distant, serene, cloud-filled sky, inviting a contemplative and expansive mood.

caption:
That constant urge to GO and DO? What if it's less about growth, and more about avoiding what's actually here? Your body remembers everything. What if we just listened?
